name: InspectorSection
label: Inspector section
description: Collapsible, titled run of inspector controls whose open body lets a dropdown menu open past its edge.

props.name: title
props.description: The section's heading, shown on its header row. Not the native tooltip `title` attribute.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the section is expanded (controlled). Pair with `onOpenChange`.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether an uncontrolled section starts expanded.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with the next expanded state when the header is pressed.

props.name: children
props.description: The section's controls, stacked one rhythm apart.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes, applied to the <section>.
